vb_textbox.text: There are two basket colours - red or brown.Red, purple and brown gnomes will produce red basketsblue, yellow or green gnomes will produce green basketsIf you find the value of the basket is low, select a different group of gnome coloursFor example - if when selecting red, purple or green gnomes and the value is continually low, switch to the other colours of gnomes.Keep selecting that colour group until the basket value gets very low and then switch
